tracks.title: theAngelcy - My Baby Boy
tracks.description: Plucked strings, a chorus of voices and Rotem Bar Or's raw tenor make this Tel Aviv folk song feel like a lullaby sung in a dark, uneasy time.

tracks.title: filous, LissA - Feel Good Inc.
tracks.description: filous strips the Gorillaz classic down to soft plucked guitar and airy beats, and LissA's gentle voice turns the old windmill anthem into a hazy daydream.

tracks.title: ayokay, Quinn XCII - Kings of Summer
tracks.description: Bright synths and Quinn XCII's easy vocal paint a road-trip memory of summers when you and your friends felt untouchable.

tracks.title: Yoko Duo, Stimming - Close These Curtains (Stimming Remix)
tracks.description: Stimming wraps Yoko Duo's fragile song in velvet: a slow, organic deep house remix full of soft textures, a hushed vocal and the feeling of a room going quiet.

tracks.title: Whilk & Misky - I Want Your Lovin' (Edit)
tracks.description: Whilk & Misky's London soul-pop at its most direct: a warm, swinging groove and a voice that asks for exactly one thing, over and over, until you want it too.

tracks.title: Whilk & Misky - Get What We Want
tracks.description: Whilk & Misky blend acoustic warmth with electronic pulse on this track from My Round, a soulful voice and a steady, rolling groove chasing a simple wish: to get what we want.

tracks.title: Whilk & Misky - Clap Your Hands
tracks.description: A barefoot, sun-dappled folk song with a bossa nova sway, acoustic guitar and handclaps that turn a simple refrain into an irresistible invitation to join in.

tracks.title: Whilk & Misky - Babe I'm Yours
tracks.description: A hushed, smoky vocal floats over plucked folk guitar and a slow electronic pulse, turning a simple declaration of devotion into a late-night confession.

tracks.title: Waldeck - Memories
tracks.description: Waldeck sets Zeebee's smoky voice inside a crackling, sepia-toned ballroom swing, a downtempo daydream about a love that only lives on in memory.

tracks.title: WHTKD - Say to Me
tracks.description: WHTKD loops a soulful, pleading vocal over a warm, rolling deep house groove, a track that sounds like late afternoon turning into evening.

tracks.title: Tiggs Da Author - Georgia
tracks.description: Tiggs Da Author's raspy, swaggering vocal rides a vintage soul sample and a hip-hop bounce on a love song that melts like snow in winter sunshine.

tracks.title: The Supermen Lovers, Jay Lamar, Jesse Oliver - Moments (Jay Lamar & Jesse Oliver Remix)
tracks.artist: The Supermen Lovers, Jay Lamar, Jesse Oliver
tracks.description: Helsinki's Jay Lamar and Jesse Oliver stretch The Supermen Lovers' Moments into a warm, unhurried deep house glide of soft chords, rounded bass and wistful melodies.

tracks.title: The Supermen Lovers, Herr Styler, Cristine - C'est bon
tracks.artist: The Supermen Lovers, Herr Styler, Cristine
tracks.description: A flirtatious slice of French electro-funk from Guillaume Atlan's project, two voices trading lines over a springy bassline until the title becomes a shrugging, grinning verdict on the night.

tracks.title: The Supermen Lovers - Moments
tracks.description: A warm, analog-glazed slice of French disco-funk where vocoder, pianos and a rubber-band bassline turn a fleeting moment into a long, glowing groove.

tracks.title: The Hacker, Mount Sims - Traces (Oxia Remix)
tracks.description: Oxia turns The Hacker and Mount Sims' cold-wave electro into a patient, rolling techno journey, all brooding synth lines and a build that keeps tightening the screw.

tracks.title: The Avener, Ane Brun - To Let Myself Go
tracks.description: The Avener wraps Ane Brun's fragile Scandinavian folk confession in a slow, rolling deep-house groove, turning a private surrender into a sunset dancefloor moment.

tracks.title: The Asteroids Galaxy Tour - The Sun Ain't Shining No More
tracks.track: The Sun Ain't Shining No More
tracks.description: A brassy, technicolour psych-pop stomp from Denmark, Mette Lindberg's helium-bright voice riding horns and a strutting beat that make heartbreak sound like a parade.

extra.album: The Sun Ain't Shining No More

tracks.title: TEEMID, Joie Tan - Crazy (Radio Mix)
tracks.description: Gnarls Barkley's frantic classic slowed into a hazy deep-house lullaby: TEEMID and Joie Tan make Crazy sound like a confession whispered at four in the morning.

tracks.title: Solomun - Friends
tracks.description: Nine minutes of Solomun's signature deep house, Friends rides a supple, swinging groove and moody chords that keep rising just enough to keep a dancefloor leaning in.

tracks.title: Solange - Losing You
tracks.description: Solange and Dev Hynes wrap the end of a relationship in a skittering, eighties-tinted R&B groove, a song about losing someone that somehow makes you want to dance.

tracks.title: Santé, Richard Judge - Awake
tracks.description: Santé lays a deep, rolling groove under J.U.D.G.E's grave, soulful voice, six minutes of dark-room house that feels like the first clear thought after a long night.

tracks.title: Robin Thicke, T.I., Pharrell Williams - Blurred Lines
tracks.description: A cowbell-clacking, falsetto-laced funk-pop strut from Robin Thicke, Pharrell and T.I. that owned the summer of 2013 and then the courtroom.

tracks.title: Robin Schulz, Francesco Yates - Sugar
tracks.description: Sun-bleached deep house with a falsetto-soul hook: Robin Schulz builds a sweet, bouncing groove around Francesco Yates and a wink to an early-2000s classic.

tracks.title: Recable - Big Jet Plane (Recable Remix)
tracks.description: Recable lifts Angus & Julia Stone's wistful Big Jet Plane onto a gently rolling house groove, keeping the song's daydream of flying away intact.

tracks.title: Queen, The Miami Project - Another One Bites The Dust (A Skillz Remix)
tracks.track: Another One Bites The Dust (A Skillz Remix)
tracks.description: A Skillz chops John Deacon's immortal bassline into a strutting breakbeat workout, keeping Freddie Mercury's swagger front and centre while the drums hit like a b-boy battle.

tracks.title: Polo & Pan - Canopée
tracks.description: Mallets, breathy vocals and a lazy tropical groove: Canopée is Polo & Pan's invitation to climb into the treetops and forget the city for four and a half minutes.

tracks.title: Platinum Doug - Move On (Original Club Mix)
tracks.description: A punchy, no-nonsense club mix from Platinum Doug, where a chopped vocal and a bouncing bassline push the dancefloor forward bar after bar.

tracks.title: Pharrell Williams - Happy
tracks.description: Handclaps, a bouncing bassline and a gospel-tinged chorus make Pharrell's Despicable Me 2 song a pure shot of sunshine that became a global anthem.

tracks.title: Peaches - Pickles
tracks.description: Peaches at her most gleefully filthy: Pickles rides a stark, rubbery electro beat while she raps about desire with a grin you can hear in every line.

tracks.title: Paloma Faith - Upside Down
tracks.description: Paloma Faith's brassy, swing-tinged retro-soul romp about a world turned on its head, with a stomping rhythm section and a voice that relishes every theatrical flourish.

extra.album: Do You Want the Truth or Something Beautiful?

tracks.title: Nu, Jo.Ke - Who Loves the Sun
tracks.description: Nine sun-warmed minutes of organic deep house from the Bar 25 world, where Jo.Ke's gentle, sing-along vocal drifts over a loping groove made for golden-hour dancing.

tracks.title: Noir, Haze, Solomun - Around (Solomun Vox)
tracks.description: Solomun's vocal mix of the Noir & Haze single: a rolling, bass-heavy deep house groove under Haze's aching voice, the slow-burn anthem of the 2011 dancefloor.

tracks.title: Nils Ohrmann - In Ya Face (Original Mix)
tracks.description: Six and a half minutes of bumping Berlin house from Nils Ohrmann: a cheeky vocal taunt, a springy bassline and a groove that never lets go.

tracks.title: Niklas Ibach - Hungry (Remix)
tracks.description: Niklas Ibach slips Dotan's aching folk-pop plea onto a soft deep-house pulse, keeping the ache while giving it somewhere to move.

tracks.title: Nicolas Jaar - Time For Us
tracks.description: A young Nicolas Jaar's slow, sultry minimal-house classic, a crooned vocal and dusty, swaying textures that famously sink from dance tempo into a long, swooning breakdown nobody wants to mix out of.

tracks.title: Nappy Roots - Good Day
tracks.description: Nappy Roots turn a sunny soul loop and a sing-along hook into a Southern porch-step anthem about waking up, counting blessings and hoping today goes right.

tracks.title: N.E.R.D, Clipse - Loser
tracks.description: N.E.R.D and Clipse trade swagger and sneers on a Neptunes-built cut from the Clones compilation, all bounce, attitude and Virginia cool.

tracks.title: Mount Sims, Toby Dammit - What's the Big Deal
tracks.description: Mount Sims and drummer Toby Dammit trade the club for a scuffed, shrugging groove: What's the Big Deal asks its question with a sneer and a beat that will not sit still.

tracks.title: Mount Sims, Jessie Evans - Andy of Jenny
tracks.description: A short, sharp electroclash duet where Mount Sims and Jessie Evans trade sly vocals over wiry synths and a drum machine that never stops strutting.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Together Alone
tracks.description: Cold drum machines and a detached croon from Mount Sims' UltraSex, an electroclash meditation on being close to someone and still completely on your own.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - The Bitten Bite Back
tracks.description: Cold synth stabs and a deadpan, sneering vocal turn revenge into a dancefloor chant: Mount Sims at his most wiry, sleazy and defiant.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Restless
tracks.description: Seven minutes of slow-burning tension, Restless loops a nervous synth figure and a stalking beat until the repetition itself becomes the thrill.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - No Yellow Lines
tracks.description: A night drive with the headlights off: grinding analogue bass, clipped drum machines and Mount Sims' cool, menacing croon from the darker side of electroclash.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - New Authority Volunteers
tracks.description: Mount Sims trades his electroclash gloss for the guitar-driven shadows of his post-punk turn, a short, tense blast of darkwave unease.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Hellbent
tracks.description: Mount Sims at his most driven: a tight, menacing electro pulse and a vocal that sounds determined to walk straight into trouble.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Grave
tracks.description: A slow, cold-blooded crawl through analogue synths and a graveside croon, Grave turns Mount Sims' taste for horror into five minutes of nocturnal dread.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Good Service
tracks.description: Deadpan vocals, buzzing analog synths and a drum machine with attitude: Good Service is Mount Sims serving early-2000s electroclash with a sly, suggestive grin.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - Ashes
tracks.description: A smouldering piece of dark synth-pop where cold machines and a weary croon circle the remains of something that burned out long ago.

tracks.title: Michelle Gurevich - Lovers Are Strangers
tracks.description: Michelle Gurevich croons a deadpan, candlelit elegy for love gone cold, with lo-fi synths and a slow-dance sway that make heartbreak feel strangely elegant.

tracks.title: Michelle Gurevich - First Six Months of Love
tracks.description: A slow, smoky synth ballad in which Michelle Gurevich's deadpan contralto toasts the giddy first months of a romance while already hearing the ending coming.

tracks.title: Michael Jackson - Billie Jean
tracks.description: One of pop's most recognisable bass lines carries Michael Jackson's paranoid tale of a paternity claim, a tight, shadowy groove that sounds as sharp now as it did on Thriller.

extra.album: HIStory - Past, Present and Future, Book I

tracks.title: Metronomy - Love Letters (Soulwax Remix)
tracks.description: Soulwax strip Metronomy's sixties-tinged pop down to a gleaming machine groove and then rebuild it, six and a half minutes of arpeggios, cowbell-bright drums and slow-burning release.

tracks.title: Marek Hemmann - Gemini
tracks.description: A nine-minute minimal journey from Jena, Marek Hemmann's Gemini unfolds in warm, melodic synth patterns that twist slowly around a soft but insistent kick.

tracks.title: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - The Trouble With Us
tracks.description: Marcus Marr and Chet Faker meet in a sweaty, bass-heavy disco-funk jam where a soulful plea about a relationship going wrong becomes a reason to dance.

tracks.title: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - Birthday Card
tracks.description: Nearly eight minutes of sleek Euro-house: Marcus Marr's springy bass and bright synths carry Nick Murphy's smoky voice towards a long, glittering dancefloor release.

tracks.title: Mando Diao - Dance With Somebody (Radio Version)
tracks.description: Mando Diao trade garage-rock grit for a disco-rock floor-filler, a pulsing four-to-the-floor beat and a shout-along chorus about needing someone to dance with.

tracks.title: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz - Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)
tracks.artist: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz
tracks.track: Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)
tracks.description: Robin Schulz lifts a mournful French folk song onto a bouncing deep-house beat, Nili Hadida's bleak lyric and a looping guitar riff becoming one of the biggest summer hits of 2014.

tracks.title: Lamomali, -M-, Toumani Diabaté, Amadou & Mariam - L'Âme Au Mali
tracks.description: Matthieu Chedid's Malian project gathers Toumani Diabaté's cascading kora and the voices of Amadou & Mariam into a warm, rolling love letter to the soul of Mali.

tracks.title: Labyrinth Ear - Navy Light
tracks.description: A three-minute haze of blurred synths, soft beats and a distant, weightless voice, Navy Light feels like city lights seen through rain on a night bus window.

tracks.title: Kölsch - Bloodline (feat. Tomas Høffding)
tracks.description: Kölsch's melodic techno meets Tomas Høffding's warm, weathered voice in Bloodline, a widescreen, slow-burning track that swells like a sunrise over the booth.

tracks.title: Kygo, Maty Noyes - Stay
tracks.description: Soft-focus tropical house from Kygo, with plucked melodies and a warm, pleading vocal from Maty Noyes asking someone not to leave just yet.

tracks.title: Kosheen - Addict
tracks.description: Deep, dark bass, insistent drums and Sian Evans' voice cutting through the fog: Addict opens Kosheen's Independence with the pull of something you cannot quit.

tracks.title: Klyne - Waiting
tracks.description: A slow, stripped-down slice of dark electronic R&B from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a soft, close-miked voice drifts over sparse beats and muted synths.

tracks.title: Klyne - Paralyzed
tracks.description: A hushed, slow-burning slice of electronic soul from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a fragile falsetto floats over muted beats and a heart too stunned to move.

tracks.title: Klyne - Entropy
tracks.description: A hushed, late-summer slow jam from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a feather-light falsetto floats over soft keys and a patient, rubbery beat.

tracks.title: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)
tracks.track: Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)
tracks.description: Miguel Campbell turns Alice Phoebe Lou's wistful moon song into a warm, rolling nu-disco groove, her voice floating weightless over a bassline that never stops gently pushing forward.

tracks.title: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon
tracks.description: KlangKuenstler wraps Alice Phoebe Lou's soft, folk-tinged voice in a warm, unhurried deep house shuffle that feels like a slow drive home under a full moon.

tracks.title: Klangkuenstler - Soul Digger (Original Mix)
tracks.description: A rolling tech-house groove with classic house warmth underneath: Soul Digger finds the soul in the machine and keeps the floor moving for almost seven minutes.

tracks.title: Klangkuenstler - Jam Master Jack (Original Mix)
tracks.description: A six-minute house workout from Klangkuenstler's early, groove-first years, built for the long middle stretch of a club night when the floor just wants to jack.

tracks.title: Klangkuenstler - Golden
tracks.description: A late-night techno roller from Berlin's Klangkuenstler: a big, rounded bassline, a gritty sawtooth lead and a bed of vinyl crackle that makes the dark groove feel strangely warm.

tracks.title: Kele - First Impressions
tracks.description: Kele Okereke opens his after-hours record Trick in a whisper: a cool, late-night house groove about the electricity of meeting someone new.

tracks.title: Kav Verhouzer, BullySongs - Get What You Came For
tracks.description: Sunny deep-house chords and a warm, raspy BullySongs vocal: Get What You Came For is an easygoing dancefloor invitation that never pushes, only pulls you in.

tracks.title: KANT, Leo Stannard - Close to the Wire (Club Remix)
tracks.description: KANT stretches Leo Stannard's aching vocal across a seven-minute club arrangement, melancholy piano chords and a steady deep-house pulse turning heartbreak into something you can dance through.

tracks.title: Joss Stone - Less Is More
tracks.description: A teenage Joss Stone leans into a lilting, reggae-kissed soul groove and sings about wanting less with the husky authority of a singer twice her age.

tracks.title: John Newman, Kove - Love Me Again (Kove Remix)
tracks.description: Kove drives John Newman's northern-soul plea for a second chance into rolling liquid drum and bass, the raw voice riding fast breaks and big, bright chords.

tracks.title: Jan Blomqvist, Animal Trainer - Big Jet Plane (Animal Trainer Remix)
tracks.description: Animal Trainer fold Jan Blomqvist's hushed take on Big Jet Plane into a rolling, late-night deep house remix where longing vocals drift above a patient, pulsing groove.

tracks.title: Jan Blomqvist - Big Jet Plane
tracks.description: Jan Blomqvist slows Angus & Julia Stone's folk lullaby into a long, glowing melodic-house drift, his weary vocal hovering over the pulse like a plane above night clouds.

tracks.title: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree (Rebel Remix)
tracks.description: Jennifer Lawrence's eerie Mockingjay folk song recast as an uptempo, drum-heavy rebel anthem, the unaccompanied verse growing into a pounding march with strings and a dance pulse.

tracks.title: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree
tracks.description: Jennifer Lawrence's bare, unpolished voice sings an eerie folk ballad that swells into a rebel anthem as James Newton Howard's strings and drums gather behind her.

tracks.title: Jain - So Peaceful
tracks.description: Zanaka's gentle closer, a reggae-tinged sway where Jain lets the album's travels settle into calm, sunlit contentment.

tracks.title: Jain - Mr Johnson
tracks.description: Handclap-light percussion, a bouncing bass and Jain's playful, slightly mischievous delivery make Mr Johnson one of Zanaka's sunniest little stories.

tracks.title: Jain - Hope
tracks.description: Jain's light, sing-song voice and bare-bones beat-making carry a small, sunny plea for a better world on her very first EP.

tracks.title: Jain - Come
tracks.description: Jain's debut hit is a two-and-a-half-minute burst of handclaps, whistled melody and Afro-pop bounce, light on its feet and impossible not to hum.

tracks.title: Jain - City
tracks.description: An early Jain song from the Hope EP, her bright, slightly mischievous voice riding a homemade beat that mixes pop simplicity with the rhythmic colours of her travelling childhood.

tracks.title: Ivy Levan, CADRÉ - Like A Glove
tracks.description: Ivy Levan's smoky, swaggering vocal slinks over a sleek, bass-heavy pop beat with Cadre in tow, a song that fits its title: tight, dark and made to measure.

tracks.title: Infinity Ink - Infinity
tracks.description: Infinity Ink's Infinity is a bassline-led deep house anthem whose endlessly looped, half-whispered hook has been soundtracking Ibiza sunrises since 2012.

tracks.title: Imany, Filatov & Karas - Don't Be So Shy (Filatov & Karas Remix)
tracks.track: Don't Be So Shy (Filatov & Karas Remix)
tracks.description: Imany's smoky contralto meets a sleek, pulsing deep-house remix from Filatov & Karas, turning a slow seduction into a continental dancefloor hit.

tracks.title: Hindi Zahra - Old Friends (Remastered Version)
tracks.description: A tender, unhurried acoustic song from Hindi Zahra's debut, her husky voice and gently plucked guitar turning memories of old friends into something warm and quietly aching.

tracks.title: Hindi Zahra - Music (Remastered Version)
tracks.description: Hindi Zahra sings a love letter to music itself, her warm, smoky voice swaying over nimble acoustic guitar and soft percussion that blend folk, soul and Berber roots.

tracks.title: Hindi Zahra - Beautiful Tango (Remastered Version)
tracks.description: Hindi Zahra's smoky voice glides over a lilting, desert-blues guitar and soft percussion in Beautiful Tango, a slow dance of a song that sounds like dusk in a small room.

tracks.title: Him_Self_Her, Kieran Fowkes - Gone Too Long (Original Mix)
tracks.description: A slow-rolling deep house groove under Kieran Fowkes' soulful, yearning vocal, the Leicester duo's Crosstown Rebels release made for the last, emotional hour of a night.

tracks.title: Her - Interlude
tracks.description: A brief, late-night breath on Her's first tape, the French duo's velvet electronic soul pared back to mood, space and a slow, sensual glow.

tracks.title: Her - Her
tracks.description: The French duo Her name their manifesto after themselves: a slow, sensual indie soul track of muted beats, warm bass and a voice that leans right into the microphone.

tracks.title: Gotan Project - La vigüela
tracks.description: Bandoneon, guitar and a gaucho voice drifting over a slow electronic pulse, La Vigüela is Gotan Project's tango heading out into the open pampas.

tracks.title: Gorillaz, Neneh Cherry - Kids with Guns
tracks.description: A cold, clanking Gorillaz track from Demon Days where Damon Albarn's weary vocal and Neneh Cherry's spectral backing turn a nursery-rhyme melody into a quiet alarm about children and violence.

tracks.title: Gorillaz - 19-2000 (Soulchild Remix)
tracks.description: The Soulchild Remix turns Gorillaz's woozy 19-2000 into a bright, bouncing cartoon road trip, with 2-D's sing-song hook and a chorus everyone remembers: get the cool shoeshine.

tracks.title: Gorgon City, Zak Abel, Dj Anna - Unmissable (DJ Anna Remix)
tracks.artist: Gorgon City, Zak Abel, Dj Anna
tracks.description: DJ Anna pulls Gorgon City's pop single into the dark: a heavy rolling bassline, Zak Abel's soulful voice in fragments and nearly eight minutes of late-night pressure.

tracks.title: Gorgon City, MNEK, Will Saul - Ready For Your Love (CLOSE Remix)
tracks.description: Will Saul's CLOSE stretches Gorgon City and MNEK's hit into a long, dubby deep-house journey, the soulful vocal echoing through a late-night haze.

tracks.title: Gorgon City, Katy Menditta, WEISS - Imagination (Weiss Remix)
tracks.description: WEISS strips Gorgon City's Imagination down to a swinging, bass-heavy house workout, leaving Katy Menditta's voice to flicker in and out over the groove.

tracks.title: Gorgon City, Katy Menditta - Imagination
tracks.description: A sleek, sunlit house cut where Katy Menditta's soulful vocal floats over a rubbery bassline and crisp garage-tinged drums, built for the moment a club exhales.

tracks.title: Glass Animals, Gilligan Moss - Gooey (Gilligan Moss Remix)
tracks.description: Gilligan Moss stretches Glass Animals' sticky love song into a glistening electronic daydream of chiming percussion, warped vocal slivers and a slow-blooming groove.

tracks.title: Glass Animals - Gooey
tracks.description: Glass Animals' breakout is a slow, syrupy jungle of a love song, Dave Bayley's murmured vocal drifting over finger-snap beats, soft guitar and a bassline that oozes.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore, Suffa, Logic - Willing To Die
tracks.description: Gin Wigmore's raw-throated hook meets verses from Hilltop Hoods' Suffa and Logic on a heavy, defiant anthem about loyalty you would bleed for.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Written In The Water
tracks.description: Gin Wigmore snarls through a stomping, handclap-driven blues-rock number, her raspy voice and swampy guitars squaring up to fate with a grin and a clenched fist.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - New Rush
tracks.description: Gin Wigmore's comeback single hits like a jolt of adrenaline, pounding drums and a chant-along chorus pushing her husky voice towards a fresh start.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Man Like That
tracks.description: A stomping, hand-clapped blues-soul strut in which Gin Wigmore's raspy, fearless voice lays out exactly the kind of man she wants.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Kill Of The Night
tracks.description: Gin Wigmore's smoky rasp prowls over stomping drums and a swaggering, bluesy strut, a midnight hunt sung by someone who fully intends to win.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Hey Ho
tracks.description: A stomping, hand-clapping slice of retro soul-pop from Gin Wigmore's debut, her gravel-and-honey voice making a breezy chant sound like a dare.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Dirty Mercy
tracks.description: Swaggering and swampy, Dirty Mercy pairs Gin Wigmore's raspy snarl with a stomping groove and a sly, sinister edge, the opening shot of her Ivory era.

tracks.title: Gin Wigmore - Black Sheep
tracks.description: Stomping drums, handclaps and a shout-along hook frame Gin Wigmore's gravel-edged voice in a proud anthem for everyone who never fit the flock.

tracks.title: Gabriella Cilmi - Left With Someone Else
tracks.description: A smoky, retro-soul kiss-off: Gabriella Cilmi watches an old flame walk out with somebody new and answers with a vocal that is pure venom wrapped in velvet.

tracks.title: Gabriella Cilmi - Cry Me A River (Live Version)
tracks.description: A teenage Gabriella Cilmi takes Justin Timberlake's break-up hit into smoky, live soul territory, her husky voice carrying all the hurt over a sparse, swinging band.

tracks.title: Future Forward, Mount Sims - Time for Livin
tracks.description: A long, strutting electro groove released on Kompute Musik, with Mount Sims' deadpan vocal riding cold analogue-style synths and a relentless machine pulse.

tracks.title: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep (HV Thrillseeker Mix)
tracks.description: The HV Thrillseeker Mix stretches The Creep into a longer, harder club tool, with the menace of the original pushed through a relentless, driving groove.

tracks.title: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep (Capri Mix)
tracks.description: A long, prowling electro mix that keeps its shadows close: The Creep in its Capri Mix stretches Mount Sims' sly menace over six and a half minutes of pulsing synths.

tracks.title: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep
tracks.description: Future Forward Society and Mount Sims build a slinking, shadowy electro crawl, all low-slung bass, cold synths and a voice that seems to whisper from the corner of the room.

tracks.title: Foster The People - Pumped Up Kicks
tracks.description: A breezy, whistled indie-pop earworm with a chilling story underneath, the song that turned Foster The People from a home demo into a global name.

tracks.title: Format:B - Chunky (Radio Edit)
tracks.description: A rubbery, swaggering tech-house stomper from Berlin's Format:B, all fat bass wobble and cheeky chopped vocals, cut down to a radio-sized strut.

tracks.title: Flume - Holdin On
tracks.description: A chopped-up soul vocal, wobbling synth chords and a swinging, head-nodding beat: Flume's breakout cut is two and a half minutes of pure, woozy elation.

tracks.title: Faul & Wad, PNAU - Changes
tracks.description: Faul & Wad Ad build a sax-lit, bittersweet house groove around the children's-choir refrain of Pnau's Baby, a song about growing up that became a European number one.

tracks.title: FKJ - Lying Together
tracks.description: The neo-house track that introduced FKJ: chopped vocals, warm filtered chords and an elastic bassline wrapped into four and a half minutes of slow-burning, sunlit intimacy.

tracks.title: Ed Sheeran - Shape of You
tracks.description: A plucked marimba-like loop, a dancehall bounce and a flirtation that starts at the bar: Shape of You is the minimal pop machine that took over the world in 2017.

tracks.title: Dusty Kid - Nemur (Walls of Guitars) (Extended Version)
tracks.description: The Sardinian techno producer closes his debut album with an unexpected, tender song of layered acoustic guitars and a fragile voice that swells into a wall of sound.

tracks.title: Drake, The Throne - Pop Style
tracks.description: Drake trades bars with Kanye West and Jay-Z over a murky, minimal beat of deep sub-bass and dry drums, a cool, understated flex from the Views era.

tracks.title: Depeche Mode - Wrong (Live in Barcelona)
tracks.description: Depeche Mode's jagged litany of mistakes, hammered out live in Barcelona with snarling synths, live drums and Dave Gahan relishing every bad decision.

tracks.title: David Lynch, Karen O - Pinky's Dream (Trentemøller Remix Instrumental)
tracks.description: Trentemøller strips Karen O away and leaves only the nightmare: a throbbing, sinister synth drive that sounds like a car speeding down a Lynchian highway at night.

tracks.title: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers - Get Lucky (Radio Edit)
tracks.artist: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers
tracks.description: Nile Rodgers' chicken-scratch guitar, Pharrell's easy falsetto and Daft Punk's robot choir turn a four-chord loop into the most irresistible disco revival of the 2010s.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
tracks.description: A chopped funk loop and a robot reciting a workout mantra: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger is Daft Punk turning a sample into one of the most quoted hooks of the century.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Give Life Back to Music
tracks.description: The curtain-raiser of Random Access Memories: live drums, Nile Rodgers' guitar and a vocoder mission statement announcing that Daft Punk came back to make music breathe again.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Giorgio by Moroder
tracks.description: Giorgio Moroder tells his own origin story over a click track, then Daft Punk unfold nine minutes of arpeggiated disco, live jazz drums and strings into a time-travelling tribute to the sound he invented.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Face to Face / Short Circuit
tracks.description: Recorded live at Bercy, Daft Punk fold the sunny house bounce of Face to Face into the jittery robot funk of Short Circuit, and the pyramid crowd goes up with it.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Episode 3, Nile Rodgers
tracks.description: Nile Rodgers tells his own story in the third of Daft Punk's Collaborators films, a warm, funny portrait of the guitarist whose rhythm runs through Random Access Memories.

tracks.title: Daft Punk - Around the World
tracks.description: One phrase, one bassline and seven minutes of perfect repetition: Around the World is Daft Punk proving that a loop can be a whole world on its own.

tracks.title: DJ S.K.T - Must Be A Reason (Radio Edit)
tracks.description: DJ S.K.T reworks the late-90s spirit of Wamdue Project's King of My Castle into a tight, sunny house edit built around one questioning vocal hook.

tracks.title: DJ Patife - Sambassim (DJ Patife Remix)
tracks.description: Fernanda Porto's breezy bossa melody rides a rolling São Paulo drum and bass break, sunlit samba swing meeting rattling breakbeats and deep sub-bass.

tracks.title: DJ Fitchie, Joe Dukie - Midnight Marauders
tracks.description: Seven unhurried minutes of Pacific dub-soul from two Fat Freddy's Drop mainstays, Joe Dukie's honeyed voice drifting over a deep, patient bassline built for the small hours.

extra.album: Late Night Tales: Nightmares on Wax

tracks.title: Corinne Bailey Rae - Put Your Records On
tracks.description: Corinne Bailey Rae's sun-dappled soul-pop single is a gentle invitation to let your hair down, all breezy guitar, brushed drums and a warm voice telling you to grow into yourself.

tracks.title: Codec & Flexor - Time Has Changed (Original)
tracks.description: Cold, pulsing analogue-style synths and a detached vocal make Codec & Flexor's electroclash-era club hit sound like a rave remembered through frosted glass.

tracks.title: Clea Vincent - All that she wants
tracks.description: Cléa Vincent turns Ace of Base's 1992 hit into breezy, homespun French synth-pop, softening its reggae-pop strut into a dreamy, lo-fi bedroom groove.

tracks.title: Claptone, Clap Your Hands Say Yeah - Ghost
tracks.artist: Claptone, Clap Your Hands Say Yeah
tracks.description: Claptone sets Alec Ounsworth's fragile, quavering indie vocal over a patient deep house groove, a dancefloor track that sounds like it is mourning something.

tracks.title: Chet Faker - Talk Is Cheap
tracks.description: A languid saxophone line, a lazy, warm beat and Chet Faker's husky croon make this Built on Glass lead single the definition of late-night electronic soul.

tracks.title: Chet Faker - Gold
tracks.description: Chet Faker's smoky late-night soul over a slow, finger-snapping electronic groove, a minimal track that gets all its heat from his weathered voice and a bassline that barely moves.

tracks.title: Camel Power Club - Ourson
tracks.description: Soft beats, sunny loops and a sampled Son House blues voice: Ourson is a short, cuddly piece of chillout that feels like a teddy bear rendered in warm sound.

tracks.title: CLAAP!, S.A.N.T.A.N.A. - Dimanche
tracks.description: A slow Sunday-afternoon deep house cut on the Paris label La Belle Records, all warm chords, an unhurried beat and a soft vocal that drifts in and out of the haze.

tracks.title: Broken Back - Happiest Man on Earth (Radio Edit)
tracks.description: Bright acoustic strumming over a gentle electronic beat, Broken Back's breakthrough single sounds like optimism earned the hard way.

tracks.title: Branko, SKIP&DIE, Fellow - Made of Gold
tracks.description: Branko's global club sound in miniature: thick bass, chattering percussion and the voices of SKIP&DIE and Fellow trading lines over a gleaming, gold-plated groove.

tracks.title: Bodyrockers - I Like The Way (Radio Edit)
tracks.description: A crunching dance-rock riff, a strutting beat and a hook about the way you move: Bodyrockers' 2005 floor-filler is pure, unashamed swagger.

tracks.title: Bobby Nourmand - Smokin' Joe
tracks.description: A laid-back, smoky slice of deep house where a sweet disco bassline meets a bluesy vocal, Smokin' Joe smoulders rather than explodes.

tracks.title: Bob Moses - Tearing Me Up
tracks.description: Bob Moses stretch a smoky, heartsick vocal across a slow-burning deep house groove, all brooding guitar, rolling bass and late-night tension that never quite breaks.

tracks.title: Blankets - The Hanging Tree
tracks.description: Blankets carries the Mockingjay murder ballad out of the woods and onto the dancefloor, setting its chilling refrain against a pulsing electronic beat.

tracks.title: Big Data, Joywave - Dangerous
tracks.description: A strutting, paranoid electro-rock stomp where Joywave's Daniel Armbruster sneers the hook over clipped funk guitar, heavy handclaps and a bassline built for headphones and dance floors alike.

tracks.title: Ben Khan - Savage
tracks.description: Two and a half minutes of warped, woozy funk: Ben Khan's cool falsetto slides over wobbling synths, guitar stabs and brass that sounds trapped inside a bubble.

tracks.title: Basement Jaxx - Galactical
tracks.description: Bright, bouncing and slightly unhinged, Galactical sends Basement Jaxx and singer Vula off into space on a house groove built for dancing in zero gravity.

tracks.title: Ayọ - Down On My Knees
tracks.description: Ayọ pleads for a lost love over a bare acoustic guitar and a gentle reggae lilt, her husky voice carrying more ache than any big arrangement could.

tracks.title: Axwell, Max C - I Found U (Radio Edit)
tracks.description: Axwell's piano-lit house anthem distilled to three minutes: a rolling bassline, a gospel-tinged vocal from Max'C and a chorus built for arms in the air.

tracks.title: Axwell - Feel The Vibe
tracks.description: Axwell's 2004 club record in its original long form: a pumping, filtered house groove that keeps building until the whole floor is lifted with it.

tracks.title: Avicii - Feeling Good
tracks.description: Avicii wraps the Nina Simone standard in soft, swelling synths and lets Audra Mae's smoky, soaring voice carry a song about new dawns and starting over.

tracks.title: Asaf Avidan & the Mojos - Reckoning Song (One Day)
tracks.description: A cracked, ageless voice over a few acoustic chords: the original Reckoning Song is a campfire confession about growing old before the remix turned it into a festival anthem.

tracks.title: Arctic Monkeys - Snap Out Of It
tracks.description: Alex Turner pleads with a lover to wake up from someone else's spell over a swaggering, hand-clapped glam-rock shuffle and a falsetto hook that sticks for days.

tracks.title: Arctic Monkeys - R U Mine?
tracks.description: Arctic Monkeys turn a jealous late-night text into a riff-heavy stomp, with Alex Turner's rapid-fire wordplay riding a fuzzed-out, swaggering guitar line.

tracks.title: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know?
tracks.description: A heavy, crawling riff, stomping handclaps and a late-night text that should never have been sent: Do I Wanna Know? turns romantic doubt into slow-burning swagger.

tracks.title: Anna Lunoe - Radioactive
tracks.description: Anna Lunoe's Radioactive is a strobe-lit house banger, all clipped vocal chops, rave stabs and a low end built to rattle a festival tent.

tracks.title: Angus & Julia Stone - Big Jet Plane
tracks.description: Soft guitars, sibling harmonies and a daydream of flying away with someone: Big Jet Plane drifts in slowly and stays with you long after it lands.

tracks.title: Amy Winehouse - You Know I'm No Good
tracks.description: A slinking, horn-stabbed confession of infidelity, sung by Amy Winehouse with brutal honesty over Mark Ronson's retro-soul swagger.

tracks.title: Alle Farben, Graham Candy - Sometimes
tracks.description: Alle Farben's sun-warmed deep house meets Graham Candy's quivering, unmistakable falsetto in a wistful Berlin summer song about the days that do not go to plan.

tracks.title: Alicia Keys - Fallin'
tracks.description: A twenty-year-old Alicia Keys at the piano, pouring gospel-sized yearning into a stark, minor-key confession about a love she cannot stop falling into.

tracks.title: Adam Freeland - Do You
tracks.description: Melodic synths crash into live drums and a snarling rock vocal: Do You opens Freeland's Cope with a breakbeat-punk jolt that sounds like a band and a DJ at war.

tracks.title: AWOLNATION - Sail
tracks.description: A slow, menacing electro-rock crawl that erupts into a howled confession, AWOLNATION's Sail is equal parts dread and release.

tracks.title: Time Has Changed (Northern Lite Remix) - Codec & Flexor

tracks.description: An electrifying fusion of minimal electro and melodic techno, reimagined with Northern Lite's signature touch.

tracks.title: Chicks On Speed - Euro Trash Girl

tracks.title: Louisahhh - Like A Vice

tracks.title: Pigeon - The Bomb

tracks.title: Electric Guest - This Head I Hold
tracks.description: An introspective yet uplifting track, 'This Head I Hold' by Electric Guest brings a heartfelt message of self-reflection and resilience, with its soulful melodies and tender vocals.

tracks.title: C2C feat. Pigeon John - Because of You
tracks.description: 'Because of You' by C2C featuring Pigeon John is a vibrant blend of hip-hop, electronic, and soul. The track combines smooth grooves with uplifting lyrics, celebrating gratitude and the impact others have on our lives.

tracks.title: Bakermat - The River
tracks.description: 'The River' by Bakermat is a soulful and uplifting track that blends deep house rhythms with gospel-inspired vocals, creating a captivating experience that invites listeners to reflect and feel inspired.

tracks.title: Sweeter Than Sweet (feat. Alice Carreri)

tracks.title: Mickey Avalon, Eli - Ultra-Violence

tracks.title: Kazy Lambist - Doing Yoga
tracks.description: A smooth, sunlit groove from Kazy Lambist that blends laid-back electronic beats with a playful melody, capturing a breezy, carefree mood.

tracks.title: Eli - Faster You Fall
tracks.description: An intense journey through heartbreak and self-discovery, Eli's 'Faster You Fall' blends soulful vocals with driving beats, capturing the complexity of love and vulnerability.

tracks.title: Moisture, Lucca Santucci - Headman (Club Version)
tracks.description: A sleek and rhythmic journey into the deep house realm, featuring hypnotic beats and soulful vocals that command the dance floor.

tracks.title: Knopfauge - Saschienne
tracks.description: A mesmerizing blend of electronic and experimental sounds, 'Saschienne' showcases Knopfauge's unique ability to weave intricate rhythms with haunting melodies.

tracks.title: Bonaparte, Acid Pauli - Not Today
tracks.description: A vibrant collaboration that melds Bonaparte's theatrical flair with Acid Pauli's eclectic sound, 'Not Today' delivers a captivating blend of electronic beats and lyrical introspection.

tracks.title: Sworn Virgins - Burning of My Clothes
tracks.description: A fierce and unapologetic electro-punk track that blends gritty vocals with pulsating beats to create an anthem of liberation and self-destruction.

tracks.title: Aloe Blacc - I Need a Dollar (Live)
tracks.description: A soulful anthem that blends heartfelt lyrics with a smooth, rhythmic performance, reflecting on the struggles and triumphs of daily life.

tracks.title: IDLES - The Wheel
tracks.description: A powerful exploration of life's cyclical nature, blending raw punk energy with poignant lyrics that reflect on resilience and vulnerability.

tracks.title: C.A.R - Idle Eyes (Roman Flügel Remix)
tracks.description: A hypnotic remix by Roman Flügel that transforms 'Idle Eyes' into a minimalist, ethereal journey through electronic soundscapes.

tracks.title: 2raumwohnung - Somebody Lonely and Me (Nacht)
tracks.description: A reflective and atmospheric track, blending dreamy synths and poignant lyrics that explore themes of solitude and connection.

tracks.title: Indiana - Solo Dancing
tracks.description: A hypnotic, synth-driven exploration of independence, blending dark pop with an infectious groove.

tracks.title: Northern Lite - Trusting Blind
tracks.description: A deep exploration of Northern Lite's track 'Trusting Blind,' showcasing their unique blend of dark psychedelic techno.

tracks.title: Mafia Kvlb - Credit Card
tracks.description: A hard-hitting track that explores themes of excess and the dark side of consumer culture.

tracks.title: JPattersson - Elevator
tracks.description: A laid-back fusion of dub, reggae, and electronic beats, perfect for chilled vibes.

tracks.title: Inigo Montoya - .E.S
tracks.description: 'Inigo Montoya - .E.S' is a hypnotic fusion of electronic beats and introspective melodies, creating a dreamlike atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective journey. The track's mysterious soundscape makes it both haunting and deeply engaging.

tracks.title: Anthony Rother - Brainshaker
tracks.description: A pulsating, electro journey that merges industrial beats with dystopian themes.

tracks.title: Alic - Going Down In A Blaze Of Glory
tracks.track: Going Down In A Blaze Of Glory
tracks.description: A deep dive into the haunting realms of dark psychedelic techno, blending hypnotic rhythms with ghostly atmospheres.

tracks.title: Ultraísta - Smalltalk
tracks.description: 'Smalltalk' by Ultraísta is an innovative electro-pop track that blends intricate rhythms and captivating melodies, exploring themes of communication and connection in a digital age.

tracks.title: Mélissa Laveaux - Needle in the Hay
tracks.description: 'Needle in the Hay' by Mélissa Laveaux is a haunting and introspective cover of Elliott Smith's original song. Laveaux's unique vocal style and arrangements provide a fresh perspective on this indie folk classic, infused with elements of her Haitian-Canadian heritage and indie rock influences.

tracks.title: Marbert Rocel - Hush Now
tracks.description: 'Hush Now' by Marbert Rocel is a soulful downtempo track that blends electronic elements with soothing melodies, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and introspection.

tracks.title: Fischerspooner - Emerge
tracks.description: 'Emerge' by Fischerspooner is a groundbreaking electro-pop anthem that blends theatrical elements with infectious beats, celebrating self-expression and the avant-garde spirit of nightlife.

tracks.title: Felix Da Housecat - Madame Hollywood (feat. Miss Kittin)
tracks.description: 'Madame Hollywood' by Felix Da Housecat featuring Miss Kittin is an electrifying electro-house track that captures the glamour and grit of nightlife, blending sharp beats with provocative lyrics.

tracks.title: ACRAZE - Do It To It (feat. Cherish)
tracks.description: 'Do It To It' by ACRAZE featuring Cherish is a high-energy dance track that blends house music with early 2000s R&B vibes, creating an infectious party anthem.

tracks.title: Tinush - Sandburg
tracks.description: 'Sandburg' by Tinush is a deep and soulful house track that captivates with its smooth melodies, textured soundscapes, and hypnotic rhythms. Its intricate production and emotional depth create a mesmerizing atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective sonic journey.

tracks.title: The xx - Crystalised
tracks.description: 'Crystalised' by The xx is an evocative indie pop track blending minimalistic production with haunting vocals. Its delicate balance of intimacy and tension makes it a standout, capturing themes of vulnerability and complex relationships.

tracks.title: The Police - Roxanne
tracks.description: 'Roxanne' by The Police is a timeless blend of rock and reggae, telling the story of unrequited love and infatuation with a woman living a dangerous lifestyle. With Sting’s iconic voice and the band’s unique sound, 'Roxanne' became one of the defining tracks of the late 70s.

tracks.title: Lucky Luke - Cooler Than Me
tracks.description: 'Cooler Than Me' by Lucky Luke is a fresh take on Mike Posner's original hit, blending deep house and electronic elements to create a laid-back, catchy anthem. The track brings a modern, chill vibe while retaining the edgy attitude of the original lyrics.

tracks.title: Klangkarussell - We Want Your Soul
tracks.description: 'We Want Your Soul' by Klangkarussell is a high-energy electronic track that critiques modern consumerism. With its hypnotic beats and provocative sampled lyrics, the song delivers a bold message while maintaining an infectious groove.

tracks.title: Groove Armada - Superstylin'
tracks.description: 'Superstylin'' by Groove Armada is a high-energy fusion of house, dub, and breakbeat, featuring bold brass, reggae vocals, and infectious grooves. The track delivers an exhilarating dancefloor experience while embodying a free-spirited, celebratory vibe.

tracks.title: Gorgon City - Hard On Me
tracks.description: 'Hard On Me' by Gorgon City is a sleek, deep house track that combines pulsating rhythms with heartfelt vocals. The track encapsulates the emotional push and pull of relationships, blending smooth production with an infectious groove that resonates on both the dance floor and in personal reflection.

tracks.title: Gabriella Cilmi - Cry Me a River (Cover)
tracks.description: 'Cry Me a River' is an iconic jazz standard, and Gabriella Cilmi's soulful interpretation breathes new life into the classic. With powerful vocals and modern production, this version captures both the emotional weight and timeless essence of the song.

tracks.title: Freeland - Under Control
tracks.description: 'Under Control' by Freeland is a powerful electronic track blending breakbeats and rock influences. With gritty vocals and a driving rhythm, the song captures themes of rebellion, control, and personal freedom, delivered with a raw, intense energy.

tracks.title: Fort Minor - Remember The Name
tracks.description: 'Remember The Name' by Fort Minor is an anthem of perseverance and determination, emphasizing the hard work and dedication it takes to achieve greatness. With its iconic chorus and powerful lyrics, the track motivates listeners to stay focused and push through obstacles.

tracks.title: Eurythmics - Sweet Dreams (Ibiza Deep Summer Remix 2015)
tracks.description: This remix of the iconic 'Sweet Dreams' by Eurythmics transforms the 80s synth-pop hit into a modern deep house anthem, perfect for a summer night on the beaches of Ibiza. The remix blends the track's dark, hypnotic melodies with breezy, uplifting beats, giving it a fresh yet nostalgic vibe.

tracks.title: Can't Get You Out of My Head (Cover) - AnnenMayKantereit x Parcels
tracks.track: Can't Get You Out of My Head (Cover)

tracks.description: AnnenMayKantereit and Parcels join forces to deliver a stunning cover of Kylie Minogue’s classic 'Can’t Get You Out of My Head.' Their stripped-back acoustic version breathes new life into the iconic pop hit, bringing a soulful and melancholic twist to the original's infectious energy.

tracks.title: Asian Dub Foundation - Flyover
tracks.description: 'Flyover' by Asian Dub Foundation is a politically charged track blending dub, punk, and electronic music. With hard-hitting rhythms, sharp vocals, and a rebellious tone, the song critiques social issues and challenges the status quo with raw, confrontational energy.

tracks.title: You Bring Me Down | Funky Fat & Digitaria
tracks.description: 'You Bring Me Down' is a dynamic electronic track by Funky Fat & Digitaria that fuses groovy basslines with catchy melodies. The song captures a sense of emotional conflict, creating a danceable yet introspective listening experience.

tracks.title: Walking on the Moon | Roseaux
tracks.description: 'Walking on the Moon' is an enchanting track by Roseaux that blends dreamy melodies with ethereal vocals. This song creates a mesmerizing atmosphere, inviting listeners to experience a sonic journey that feels both otherworldly and intimate.

tracks.title: Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix) | Nina Simone
tracks.track: Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix)
tracks.description: 'Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix)' revitalizes Nina Simone's classic with pulsating house beats and deep grooves. This remix transforms the original into a vibrant dancefloor anthem that celebrates both the timelessness of Simone's voice and the modern energy of house music.

tracks.title: Sambassim | Fernanda Porto
tracks.description: 'Sambassim' is an infectious track by Fernanda Porto that blends samba rhythms with electronic elements. The song captures the vibrant spirit of Brazilian music while exploring modern production techniques.

tracks.title: Primitive | Róisín Murphy
tracks.description: 'Primitive' is a bold and captivating track by Róisín Murphy, blending elements of electronic and pop music. The song explores themes of instinct, desire, and the primal forces that drive human behavior.

tracks.title: Party Girl | Michelle Gurevich
tracks.description: 'Party Girl' is a captivating track by Michelle Gurevich, characterized by its dreamy soundscapes and introspective lyrics. The song explores themes of identity and the complexities of nightlife, creating an evocative listening experience.

tracks.title: One Night In New York City | The Horrorist
tracks.track: One Night In New York City
tracks.description: 'One Night In New York City' is a pulsating techno track by The Horrorist that captures the vibrant and chaotic essence of nightlife in the city. With its driving beats and dark, immersive atmosphere, the song invites listeners to experience the thrill of an unforgettable night out.

tracks.title: Nancy Sinatra - Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
tracks.track: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)
tracks.description: 'Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)' is a haunting ballad by Nancy Sinatra, showcasing her signature style. The song combines melancholic lyrics with a memorable melody, exploring themes of love, loss, and heartbreak.

tracks.title: My Moon My Man | Feist
tracks.description: 'My Moon My Man' is a beautifully crafted indie pop track by Feist, characterized by its enchanting melodies and introspective lyrics. The song explores themes of love and longing, creating a captivating auditory experience.

tracks.title: Midsummer Night Blues (feat. Zeebee)

tracks.description: 'Midsummer Night Blues' is an enchanting track featuring Zeebee, blending soulful melodies with a jazzy undertone, creating a vibrant and evocative sonic experience that captures the essence of summer evenings.

tracks.title: Luca Malina - FCKRZ
tracks.description: 'FCKRZ' is an electrifying electronic track by Luca Malina, blending deep house rhythms with vibrant melodies. The song captures the essence of nightlife and dance culture, creating an immersive auditory experience.

tracks.title: Lone Digger | Caravan Palace
tracks.description: 'Lone Digger' is a vibrant electro-swing track by Caravan Palace that combines vintage jazz elements with modern electronic beats. The song creates an infectious, danceable rhythm that invites listeners to join the party.

tracks.title: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger | Daft Punk | Pomplamoose
tracks.description: 'Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger' is an iconic electronic track originally by Daft Punk, reimagined by Pomplamoose. This version combines playful instrumentation with catchy vocals, creating a fresh and vibrant take on the classic.

tracks.title: Feel It Still | Portugal. The Man
tracks.description: 'Feel It Still' is a catchy, upbeat track by Portugal. The Man, featuring a blend of funk and rock elements. The song’s infectious groove and playful lyrics make it an anthem for liberation and carefree living.

tracks.title: Discolight (Hrdvsion's NSD Mix)

tracks.description: 'Discolight (Hrdvsion's NSD Mix)' is a pulsating electronic track that blends house and disco elements, creating a vibrant soundscape. The remix showcases Hrdvsion's unique style, transforming the original into an immersive dance experience.

tracks.title: Cardi B - WAP (feat. Megan Thee Stallion)
tracks.description: 'WAP' is a bold and provocative hip-hop track by Cardi B featuring Megan Thee Stallion. The song combines assertive lyrics with a catchy beat, celebrating female empowerment and sexuality in an unapologetic manner.

tracks.title: Breezeblocks | alt-J (∆)
tracks.description: 'Breezeblocks' is an innovative indie rock track by alt-J (∆), known for its catchy hooks and intriguing lyrics. The song blends eclectic sounds with a unique vocal delivery, creating a compelling auditory experience.

tracks.title: Bird of Pray | Fatboy Slim
tracks.description: 'Bird of Pray' is an eclectic track by Fatboy Slim that combines infectious beats with a captivating narrative. The song intricately weaves themes of freedom and escapism, using the imagery of the YF-118G bomber as a powerful symbol.

tracks.title: Biggest & The Best | Clawfinger
tracks.description: 'Biggest & The Best' is an energetic track by Clawfinger that combines rap metal and industrial elements. The song delivers a powerful critique of ego and self-importance, creating a high-octane listening experience.

tracks.title: Whilk & Misky - Darklands
tracks.description: 'Darklands' by Whilk & Misky is a moody electronic track that weaves haunting melodies and deep basslines, exploring themes of introspection and emotional depth.

tracks.title: Vitalic - You Prefer Cocaine
tracks.description: 'Cocaine' by Vitalic is a pulsating electro track that combines driving beats with catchy synth melodies, capturing the raw energy and intensity of nightlife and the dance floor.

tracks.title: Tum Rakak - Deluxe
tracks.description: 'Deluxe' by Tum Rakak is an energetic electronic dance track that blends elements of techno, house, and experimental electronic music. The song showcases innovative sound design and pulsating rhythms, creating an immersive sonic experience.

tracks.title: Tubbe - In Berlin
tracks.description: 'In Berlin' is an electrifying synth-pop track by Swedish artist Tubbe. The song captures the essence of Berlin's vibrant nightlife and electronic music scene, blending pulsating beats with nostalgic '80s-inspired synths and emotive vocals.

tracks.title: Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs - Garden
tracks.description: 'Garden' is a captivating electronic dance track by Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs. The song blends lush synthesizers, pulsating beats, and ethereal vocals to create an immersive sonic landscape that's both melancholic and uplifting.

tracks.title: Timo Maas - Shifter
tracks.description: Timo Maas's 'Shifter' is a driving progressive house track infused with elements of techno. The song features a deep, hypnotic groove, evolving textures, and a powerful bassline, making it a standout in the electronic music scene.

tracks.title: The Chemical Brothers - The Salmon Dance
tracks.description: 'The Salmon Dance' is a quirky and playful electronic track by The Chemical Brothers, featuring rapper Fatlip. The song blends funky beats with humorous lyrics about a fish-inspired dance, creating a unique and memorable listening experience.

tracks.title: The Chemical Brothers - Star Guitar
tracks.description: 'Star Guitar' is a mesmerizing electronic track by The Chemical Brothers. The song's hypnotic beats and ethereal synths create a captivating journey through sound, perfectly complemented by its iconic music video.

tracks.title: Soul Intoxication (Lonely Boy's Detox Dub)

tracks.description: 'Soul Intoxication (Lonely Boy's Detox Dub)' is a hypnotic electronic track that blends elements of dub, house, and ambient music. This remix explores themes of emotional cleansing and introspection through its immersive soundscape.

tracks.title: Sleaford Mods - Tweet Tweet Tweet
tracks.description: 'Tweet Tweet Tweet' by Sleaford Mods is a gritty post-punk anthem that tackles themes of social alienation and political disillusionment. With minimalistic beats and aggressive vocals, the track captures the raw frustration of the working class in modern society.

tracks.title: Nouvelle Vague - Too Drunk to Fuck
tracks.description: 'Too Drunk to Fuck' by Nouvelle Vague is a bossa nova-influenced cover of the classic Dead Kennedys punk anthem. This rendition transforms the energetic punk original into a smooth, laid-back track, highlighting the irony of its lyrics in a new, softer context.

tracks.title: Mirwais - Naiive Song
tracks.description: 'Naiive' by Mirwais is an electronic track characterized by its infectious groove and minimalist production. The song blends catchy melodies with rhythmic elements, creating a captivating listening experience that resonates with fans of innovative electronic music.

tracks.title: Miike Snow - Paddling Out
tracks.description: 'Paddling Out' by Miike Snow is an infectious indie pop track that combines catchy melodies with an upbeat rhythm. The song's vibrant production and thoughtful lyrics explore themes of self-discovery and the pursuit of happiness, inviting listeners to embrace life's adventures.

tracks.title: Kutiman - Inner Galactic Lovers
tracks.description: 'Inner Galactic Lovers' by Kutiman is an eclectic blend of funk, jazz, and electronic elements that creates a cosmic soundscape. With its captivating grooves and lush instrumentation, the track transports listeners to a vibrant, otherworldly realm.

tracks.title: Klangkarussell - Moments
tracks.description: 'Moments' by Klangkarussell is an enchanting electronic track that blends deep house vibes with melodic undertones. The song creates a euphoric atmosphere, inviting listeners to immerse themselves in a soundscape that evokes feelings of nostalgia and joy.

tracks.title: K.Flay - High Enough
tracks.description: K.Flay’s 'High Enough' is an alternative rock track with electronic and hip-hop influences. The song explores themes of self-sufficiency and contentment, rejecting external substances to find fulfillment within oneself.

tracks.title: Joris Delacroix - Epoque
tracks.description: 'Epoque' by Joris Delacroix is an atmospheric deep house track with a blend of melodic elements and driving rhythms. The song carries a reflective and nostalgic tone, taking the listener on an emotive journey through sound.

tracks.title: Jan Blomqvist - Time Again
tracks.description: 'Time Again' by Jan Blomqvist is a minimal techno and deep house hybrid track, featuring melancholic melodies and an entrancing vocal performance. The song encapsulates the artist's ability to create an emotional and hypnotic atmosphere while maintaining a danceable groove.

tracks.title: Jain - Makeba
tracks.description: “Makeba” by Jain is an upbeat and catchy fusion of world music and electronic pop. The song is a tribute to South African civil rights activist Miriam Makeba, blending rhythmic Afrobeat influences with modern pop elements to create an infectious and energetic track.

tracks.title: H.E.R. - Five Minutes
tracks.description: 'Five Minutes' by H.E.R. is a soulful R&B track that explores themes of longing and emotional vulnerability. With its smooth melodies and heartfelt lyrics, the song captures the essence of wanting to connect deeply with someone special.

tracks.title: Gregory Porter - Do Not Lose Your Steam
tracks.description: 'Do Not Lose Your Steam' by Gregory Porter is an uplifting jazz-infused track that combines soulful vocals with rich instrumentation. The song conveys a powerful message of perseverance and resilience, encouraging listeners to keep pushing forward despite challenges.

tracks.title: Felix Da Housecat - Silver Screen (Shower Scene)
tracks.description: 'Silver Screen (Shower Scene)' by Felix Da Housecat is a captivating electro-house track that weaves together cinematic soundscapes with pulsating beats, exploring themes of desire and seduction.

tracks.title: Dead Kennedys - Too Drunk to Fuck
tracks.description: 'Too Drunk to Fuck' by Dead Kennedys is a punk rock anthem that critiques drunken behavior and its implications on relationships. With its energetic tempo and sharp lyrics, the song captures the essence of the punk movement's irreverence and social commentary.

tracks.title: Björk - Káta Rókkar
tracks.description: 'Káta Rókkar' by Björk is a captivating track that showcases her unique blend of electronic and organic sounds. The song features intricate arrangements and emotive vocals, drawing listeners into a world of layered textures and rich sonic landscapes.

tracks.title: Alif Tree - Forgotten Places
tracks.description: 'Forgotten Places' is a mesmerizing downtempo track by Alif Tree. The song blends atmospheric textures with jazzy elements, creating a nostalgic and introspective sonic journey that evokes images of hidden, abandoned spaces reclaimed by nature.

tracks.title: Zwicker - Oddity (feat. Olivera Stanimirov)
tracks.description: 'Oddity' is a mesmerizing track by Zwicker featuring Olivera Stanimirov, blending electronic rhythms with sultry vocals. The song weaves a hypnotic atmosphere, inviting listeners into a world of seductive beats and alluring melodies.

tracks.title: Say Yes Dog - A Friend
tracks.description: 'A Friend' by Say Yes Dog is a lively, feel-good blend of synth-pop and indie dance. The track celebrates the joy of friendship, combining infectious beats with heartfelt lyrics.

tracks.title: Ryan Blyth - Once Twice feat. Rachel K Collier
tracks.track: Once Twice feat. Rachel K Collier
tracks.description: 'Once Twice' is an uplifting house track by Ryan Blyth featuring Rachel K Collier. The song blends energizing rhythms with soulful vocals, creating an atmosphere that invites listeners to dance and feel inspired.

tracks.title: Pilocka Krach - La Luna Y El Sol
tracks.description: An energetic fusion of cumbia and electronic music, capturing the joy of celebration and individuality.

tracks.title: Paul Oakenfold feat. Pharrell Williams - Sex 'N' Money
tracks.description: 'Sex 'N' Money' is a pulsing electronic track from Paul Oakenfold featuring Pharrell Williams. With hypnotic beats and provocative lyrics, the song explores themes of excess and indulgence in the world of fame.

tracks.title: Mount Sims - How We Do
tracks.description: 'How We Do' is a dark, pulsing electronic track that dives into the depths of underground sounds. With gritty beats and haunting melodies, the song captures a raw and rebellious energy, drawing listeners into a world where the rules of conformity are left behind.

tracks.title: Miss Kittin - Frank Sinatra
tracks.description: 'Frank Sinatra' is an iconic electroclash track that combines deadpan vocals with raw electronic beats, offering a satirical take on celebrity culture, excess, and fame, while keeping a danceable edge.

tracks.title: Louie Austen - One Night In Rio
tracks.description: 'One Night In Rio' by Louie Austen is a smooth and seductive jazz-infused track, capturing the exotic allure and mystery of a fleeting night in the vibrant city of Rio.

tracks.title: Lekota - I Used To
tracks.description: Lekota's I Used To combines nostalgic melodies with a modern electronic sound, creating an emotive and introspective listening experience.

tracks.title: Kollektiv Turmstrasse - On The Streets (Let Freedom)
tracks.description: 'On The Streets (Let Freedom)' by Kollektiv Turmstrasse is an atmospheric electronic track that blends deep beats with a message of liberation and freedom.

tracks.title: Justice Vs Simian - We Are Your Friends
tracks.description: 'We Are Your Friends' is an iconic electro house anthem by Justice Vs Simian. The track masterfully blends punchy beats with infectious vocals, creating an unforgettable experience on the dance floor.

tracks.title: Jorge Ben Jr - Take It Easy My Brother Charles
tracks.track: Take It Easy My Brother Charles
tracks.description: Jorge Ben Jr's 'Take It Easy My Brother Charles' is a laid-back, funky Brazilian anthem that blends samba rhythms with soulful vocals. This classic track radiates a timeless groove, bringing together a perfect balance of cool, smooth energy with just the right amount of swagger.

tracks.title: Hindi Zahra - Stand Up
tracks.description: 'Stand Up' by Hindi Zahra is a soulful anthem infused with a rebellious spirit, blending elements of jazz, folk, and world music. Its rich, earthy tone invites listeners to rise and move to the rhythm of empowerment.

tracks.title: Gabriel Vitel - Burn It Down
tracks.description: 'Burn It Down' by Gabriel Vitel is an intense and electrifying track, blending dark electronic beats with emotionally charged vocals.

tracks.title: Controller 7 - Get Ready for the Young Folks
tracks.track: Get Ready for the Young Folks
tracks.description: 'Get Ready for the Young Folks' by Controller 7 is an exhilarating blend of electronic and hip-hop influences that captures the spirit of youth and adventure.

tracks.title: Bronski Beat - Small Town Boy
tracks.description: 'Small Town Boy' by Bronski Beat is a profound narrative of isolation, identity, and the struggle for acceptance, resonating with those who feel the need to escape and fight for their place in the world.

tracks.title: Amanda Blank - DJ
tracks.description: 'DJ' by Amanda Blank is a high-energy electro-rap track with a party vibe, showcasing her dynamic style and bold lyrics.

tracks.title: Marcu Rares - Camimosa
tracks.description: Refreshing fusion of deep house and ambient electronica.

tracks.title: Lipka - No More Bier
tracks.description: The essence of carefree nights and the bittersweet feeling of saying goodbye to good times.

tracks.title: Ladytron - Seventeen
tracks.description: Captivating blend of synth-pop and electronic vibes, showcasing the band's signature sound.

tracks.title: Chris Lorenzo & The Streets - Take Me as I Am
tracks.description: This song delivers a captivating blend of electronic beats and urban vibes. Its infectious energy and engaging lyrics create an atmosphere that invites listeners to embrace their true selves.
